_comment: Per-route payload ledger, enforced by scripts/check-route-budget.mjs at the end of the docs build (blocking in CI via docs-build). Each metric has a SOFT target and a CEILING (hard). Over the ceiling fails; more than 5% under soft fails as STALE. A PR may add up to 2KB of eager JS per route over main while the route stays at or under soft; every byte above soft is declared in the PR's own docs/route-budget.d/<slug>.md (`studio: +N` plus why). Change these numbers only with `npm run route-budget:rebaseline`, which writes docs/route-budget.history.md too; a test holds this file to the newest history row, and CI flags any raise over the base on the job summary. Raising soft (--raise) or a ceiling (--ceiling) needs the owner's OK. Why: engineering/decisions/2026-09-29-route-budget-soft-hard.md.
_units: bytes. eagerJsGz = gzip(level 6) of every /_astro/*.js the route's HTML references plus everything those import statically. engineJsGz = gzip(level 6) of the engine boot entries the route's HTML names (/playground/v/<hash>/lattice-playground.js and lattice-runtime.js) plus everything they import statically; lazy providers beside them are not counted. chartKernelGz (studio only) = gzip of the largest esm/chart-<layout>.js closure beyond the engine. chartKernelsGz (studio only) = gzip of the union of every esm/chart-<layout>.js closure beyond the engine, each shared chunk counted once. lintCoreGz (studio only) = gzip of the lint core (esm/lint.js beside the engine) and its static imports beyond the engine's own closure. htmlRaw = the HTML document itself.
